CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

2. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Hosea? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Hosea.
   B. Use Prophet Hosea to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Prophet Hosea has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Say Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

8. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection? (1 mark)
